limitations: Calendar versions are not bound on the resource master; schedule and capacity resolution keep using the versioned calendar facts that already carry versions.
The project calendar selector in the schedule cycle is the D3b surface; this stage verifies it reads the stored catalogue, and full calendar lifecycle work continues in D3d.
